request: Make the approved item-reference design consistent everywhere it applies, including the older Elixir of Detection preview inside Recipe Book.
cause: ItemReferenceCard selected the new Joined copper design only when onClose was provided. Artwork tooltips omitted that callback and rendered a separate legacy all-in-one card.
implementation: ItemReferenceCard now always renders the shared Joined reference. No appearance switch based on close-callback presence and no duplicate legacy popup renderer.

Interactive artwork previews use the same attached Recipe/Details and Used for tabs, theme-adaptive finish, artwork rows, quantities beside names, actual-content height and scroll limit as opened windows.

Hover tab/copy interactions do not trigger Tooltip's default tap dismissal. Leaving, an outside tap or the close control dismisses the preview. Existing pin actions, host navigation and explicit recipe activation remain.
The shared card contains scroll notifications, including nested tooltip overlays, so scrolling does not dismiss or move its containing recipe panel.

Explicitly passive exchange hovers retain all reference facts in one reading body with the same finish/rows, without unusable tabs, recipe actions or focus targets. Click still opens the full interactive window. Exact supplied exchange artwork is retained.

Preserve the neutral unknown-item message and quantity/alternative accessibility labels in the unified renderer. No new ordinary hover labels, settings, saved-data fields, formulas or reference-data changes.

scope: All shared item-reference windows and existing artwork previews; not a redesign of unrelated Inventory editors, map panels or other application dialogs.

verification.coverage: Real app -> Planner -> Recipe Book -> nested Elixir of Detection hover/pin in every supported theme and 100%/200% text; live theme switching; passive custom-art facts; hover tab interaction; viewport, wheel limits and background offsets; copying, formula identity/activation and host navigation.
verification.testMaintenance: Replaced legacy-layout assertions with tab-aware checks and retained exact facts, quantities, artwork and actions. Six stale Opportunities-hover failures reproduced on the unchanged preceding snapshot; tests now use the existing explicit View recipe action instead of expecting the newer Craft or sell icon to open a dialog. No Opportunities navigation code was changed.

preservation: Complete Legacy Instance Handoff source snapshot and runnable preserved before edits. All native instance handling, shared Documents/writer lease/format/migration guards and previous changes are inherited unchanged. HEAD alone is not the candidate.
releaseStatus: Separate test build only. No personal profile access, visible app launch, installed replacement, shortcut change, handoff or publication.
